title: HTTP JSON
description: Polls any JSON HTTP API and maps the response to observations through a field map. The URL, headers and POST body may carry placeholders filled per request: {lat} {lon} {radius_nm} {radius_km} {north} {south} {east} {west} {bbox} {now_unix}.

url.title: Request URL
url.description: Placeholders are substituted per request; area placeholders come from each box of the active area of interest, or from the whole globe without one. {bbox} expands to south,west,north,east.

body.title: POST body
body.description: Sent as JSON with the same placeholders as the URL (a string is sent verbatim after substitution). Ignored for GET.

headers.title: Request headers
headers.description: Values may use the same placeholders as the URL.

maxIntervalSec.title: Slowest poll interval (s)
maxIntervalSec.description: Used when the area is large or the remote quota runs low.

maxAreaSqDeg.title: Area above which polling slows (sq deg)
maxAreaSqDeg.description: The interval stretches by ceil(area / maxAreaSqDeg) up to maxIntervalSec. 0 disables.

requireArea.title: Poll only the clients' viewport
requireArea.description: true idles the feed until the API gateway pushes an active area; false polls continuously, with the pushed area when there is one and the globe otherwise.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Secrets come from secretRefs: password (basic), token (bearer, header), clientSecret (oauth2_client_credentials).

username.title: Username
username.description: basic: paired with the password secret.

headerName.title: Header name
headerName.description: header: the request header that carries the token secret, e.g. X-API-Key.

clientId.title: OAuth client id
clientId.description: oauth2_client_credentials; may also come from the clientId secret.

decoder.title: Decoder
decoder.description: Options of the json decoder: how the response maps to observations.

records.title: Records path
records.description: Dotted path to the array of records; empty when the document is one record or a bare array.

identityType.title: Identity type of the id field
identityType.description: ICAO24, MMSI, NORAD_ID, COT_UID, ...; empty means feed-local.

timeFormat.title: Timestamp format
timeFormat.description: A Go layout, unix or unixms; empty accepts RFC 3339 or numeric unix.

entityType.title: Entity type when the record has none

source.title: Entity source
source.description: EntitySource name written on observations; default UNSPECIFIED.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Observation field to dotted JSON path.

rateLimitHeader.title: Rate limit header
rateLimitHeader.description: Response header carrying the remaining quota, e.g. X-RateLimit-Remaining. Below creditFloor the feed polls at the slowest interval.
